Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Σέργιος και Βάκχος», with the rank word left off.
The bare name out of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1975, headed «Сергий Римлянин, Росафский, мч.», with the rank word and the two epithets left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 7. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Сергије и Вакх“ — Св. is «saint» and not a rank and муч. is the martyr grade this corpus puts in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name, the first of the heading’s two, is the whole of the form. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so this is the first holder; the Serbian vernacular ending keeps it off the six-folder «Сергий» fold.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 7 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Сергия и Вакха (290-303).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the day's one icon, «Совершается служба на шесть» — a service of six stichera. It stands immediately before this line, which is the first of the day, and the day's service block names this pair and nobody else: «7 октября: Святых мучеников Сергия и Вакха». The three later paragraphs carry no icon and no rank is read onto them.

attestations.note: The Russian prints a span of years where neither saint.gr nor doxologia.ro prints any, and the folder's `dates` now carry it. Its index of names calls him «Сергий Римлянин, Росафский, мч.», of Rosaf, which is the city the Romanian life has him beheaded at.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 7 octombrie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Serghie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Σέργιος και Βάκχος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is plainly the same pair: the two soldiers of Maximian, the duke Antiochus of the East who had Bacchus scourged to death and Sergius beheaded. saint.gr gives no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. It records relics at length — the skulls of both at the monastery of Curtea de Argeș in Romania, portions at Vatopedi and at the Alexander Nevsky Lavra, and Western claims at Venice, Pavia, Heiligenstadt, Wiessenburg and Prague — and says that in 547 Justinian raised the church called «Μικρή Αγία Σοφία» in Constantinople in their honour and laid their relics there. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints an apolytikion and a kontakion, both of which belong to the pair; it also prints an Οἶκος and a Κάθισμα, which are not kinds the schema holds and are not drafted.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 20.10.2026 (7. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Сергије и Вакх“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, the first of its two names. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE HEADING IS AN ENUMERATED COMPANY OF TWO and §5 counts the names it prints: Сергије and Вакх, two names, therefore up to two folders, and the corpus already holds both — so the entry is two upgrades and no arrival. The quoted line is the one heading, whole, on both rows. THE RANK WORD IS муч., martyr by §5, and `types` IS LEFT AT `great-martyr`, WHICH IS NOT A CORRECTION OF IT: the folder took `great-martyr` from doxologia’s «Sfantul Mare Mucenic» and the Greek page, three books against one abbreviation, and a scalar field has no «X or Y» — the Prologue’s grade is recorded here instead. `dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE PROLOGUE IS THE REASON IT COULD NOT MOVE. The folder holds `death` 290–303 off the Russian day line «Мчч. Сергия и Вакха (290-303)»; this entry closes «Пострадаше ови красни витези вере Христове око 303. г.», about 303, which lies inside the span the folder already carries. **Taking it would narrow a source’s range to one end of itself**, which is refused, and widening is for two books that disagree — these two agree. NO NEW `related`: Maximian is an emperor in a life and the governor Antiochus is the adversary of the story, and neither is a relation; the pair already relate each other. No `locations` — the entry names Rome, Barbalissos and Rosaf and the folder has never been placed, and a located saint with a thirteen-year death span is a `map-span` question nobody asked. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. WHAT THIS FOURTH BOOK ADDS TO A 5 kB LIFE, which already carries the Romanian, the Greek and the Russian. Most of the entry is here already: the two as the first nobles at Maximian’s court, the emperor’s love turning to anger when he heard they were Christians, the great sacrifice they openly refused, the stripping of the soldier’s dress, the rings and the decorations, the women’s clothes, the iron hoops about the neck, the parade for the mockery of all, the sending into Asia to the governor Antiochus who owed his own rise to their recommendation, Bacchus beaten to death while Sergius lay in prison, the iron shoes stuck full of nails, and the beheading at Rosaf. THREE THINGS ARE NEW. The parade is **through the streets of the city of Rome**, which no page read for this folder names. Rosaf is **in Syria**, where the Romanian gives the city with no province. And the two answer Antiochus in one sentence, spoken for both of them: „и чест и бешчешће, и живот и смрт – све је једно ономе ко иште царства небескога.“ — both honour and dishonour, both life and death, are all one to him who seeks the kingdom of heaven. It is a different saying from the one the Greek page gives Sergius at the end, the Apostle’s «Ἐμοὶ τὸ ζῆν Χριστός», and is said here by the two together before the tortures rather than by Sergius on the block. WHAT THE PROLOGUE DOES NOT HAVE, said because its silence is not a correction: no angel heals his feet, no pillar of fire stands over the grave, no fifteen bishops translate the relics, and Justinian’s church is not mentioned. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Сергије», and it folds to `сергије`, which is **not** the `сергии` the six-folder Russian fold stands on — measured, not assumed, and the Serbian vernacular ије ending is the whole reason. No fold is widened by this day.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mari Mucenici Serghie şi Vah

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest won from thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having thy strength they overthrew their torturers and broke the powerless presumption of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ our God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Τριάδος τῆς Ἁγίας ὀπλίται τροπαιοῦχοι, ἡ λαμπρὰ δυὰς τῶν Μαρτύρων, ὠράθητε ἐν ἄθλοις, Σέργιος ὁ θεῖος ἀριστεύς, καὶ Βάκχος ὁ γενναῖος ἀθλητής, διὰ τοῦτο δοξασθέντες περιφανῶς, προΐστασθε τῶν βοώντων Δόξα τῷ ἐνισχύσαντι ὑμᾶς, δόξα τῷ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι δι' ὑμῶν, πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τοῦ λίθου σφραγισθέντος — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Σέργιος και Βάκχος», and it names both of them.

english.text: Trophy-bearing soldiers of the Holy Trinity, you were seen in your contests as the shining pair of the martyrs, Sergius the divine champion and Bacchus the noble contender; and therefore, being gloriously glorified, stand before those who cry out: Glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.

hymns.text: Τὸν νοῦν πρὸς ἐχθροὺς ἀνδρείως παρατάξαντες, τὴν πᾶσαν αὐτῶv ἀπάτην κατελύσατε, καὶ τὴν νίκην ἄνωθεv, εἰληφότες Μάρτυρες πανεύφημοι, ὁμοφρόνως ἐκράζετε. Καλὸν καὶ τερπνὸν τὸ συνεῖναι Χριστῷ.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — the second hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Σέργιος και Βάκχος». It is the pair's own kontakion, addressed to them as «Μάρτυρες πανεύφημοι», and names no other saint. The Οἶκος printed under it, which does name them, is not a kind the schema holds and is not drafted.

english.text: Having drawn up your minds bravely against the enemies, you undid the whole of their deceit; and having received the victory from above, all-praised martyrs, with one mind you cried out: Good and delightful it is to be with Christ.

hymns.text: Удобрение Христовых страстотерпец/ и очи Христовы Церкве,/ очи просветите душ наших,/ Сергие многострадальне и Вакше преславне:/ молитеся ко Господу,/ яко да убежим тьмы греховныя/ и Света явимся общницы невечерняго// молитвами вашими, святии.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников Сергия и Вакха»

english.text: Adornment of the passion-bearers of Christ and eyes of the Church of Christ, enlighten the eyes of our souls, much-suffering Sergius and most glorious Bacchus; pray to the Lord that we may escape the darkness of sin and be shown partakers of the light that knows no evening, by your prayers, O holy ones.

hymns.text: Разум на враги мужески вооруживше,/ всю тех лесть разрушисте,/ и победу свыше приимше, мученицы всехвальнии,/ единомысленно вопиюще:// добро и красно еже быти с Богом.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников Сергия и Вакха»

english.text: Having armed your minds manfully against the enemies, you destroyed the whole of their deceit, and receiving the victory from on high, all-praised martyrs, you cried out with one mind: good and fair it is to be with God.

death.note: The span the Russian calendar's day line prints after the pair's names: «Мчч. Сергия и Вакха (290-303)». Neither saint.gr nor doxologia.ro prints a year for either of them.
